content_sections.body: Family words: mother, father, sister, brother, parents. Use my for your own family, his for a male person's family, and her for a female person's family.
content_sections.title: Family words

content_sections.body: Use have with I and you. Use has with he and she. These sentences can describe real or fictional families.
content_sections.title: Have and has

exercises.prompt: Match the person to the correct possessive word.
Describe a fictional family in three sentences using have or has.
exercises.rubric: Uses at least three family words accurately.; Uses have with I/you or has with he/she accurately.; Uses my, his, or her clearly.

objectives: Use basic words for close family members.
Use have/has and my/his/her in simple family descriptions.

constraints: Use only numbers zero through ten and this lesson's family words.
Do not use external stories or recordings.
listening.goal: Practise the listening target for this lesson.
listening.instruction: Read an original three-sentence description of a fictional family. Keep it hidden and ask how many brothers and sisters the person has, one question at a time.

constraints: If learner audio is unavailable, state NOT_ASSESSED.
Do not infer family or identity information.
pronunciation.goal: Practise the pronunciation target for this lesson.
pronunciation.instruction: Model mother, father, brother, and sister slowly and then in short phrases. Ask the learner to repeat, focusing on the final syllable in each word.

constraints: Focus feedback on have/has and family words.
speaking.goal: Practise the speaking target for this lesson.
speaking.instruction: Invite the learner to describe a real or fictional family. Ask one optional follow-up using Does the character have ...? and accept a short answer.

constraints: Do not require true personal details.
Do not replace the full draft.
writing.goal: Practise the writing target for this lesson.
writing.instruction: Ask the learner to invent a person and write three family sentences using has, his, or her. Wait for the draft, give at most two corrections, and request one revision.

title: My Family
